name: Clear to Pay
description: Supplier-payment guard for AI agents. The AI asks; the escrow contract on Concordium decides. Clear to Pay submits supplier invoices but can never release payment on its own: the escrow pays only when two people have counted the delivery blind, the supplier has approved that exact invoice and amount from its own account, and the money goes to the supplier's own payout account after its hold. Other agents can hire it: a paid pre-clear check over x402 (0.01 CCD) returns the contract's own verdict and the checklist behind it. Its owner is proven with Concordium ID to be a verified adult living in Nigeria, anchored on-chain.

skills.name: Pre-clear a payment (paid, x402)
skills.description: Would this order's payment clear right now? Returns the escrow contract's own dry-run verdict (Cleared, Held with reasons, or Refused) plus the checklist behind it: delivery counts, invoice and supplier approval, payout account and its hold, deadline. Nothing is sent to the escrow. Pay per request over x402: GET https://cleartopay-concordium.vercel.app/api/preclear?order=<n>[&escrow=<index>] answers 402 with the payment requirements; pay 0.01 CCD (exact scheme, Concordium testnet, gas sponsored) and get the answer. Works for any escrow running the Verified Clear to Pay module.

skills.name: Submit and check an invoice
skills.description: Submits a supplier invoice's SHA-256 fingerprint to a Clear to Pay escrow and asks for payment. Never pays: the contract decides, and answers Cleared or Held with reason codes, on-chain.
